content:
maria: Heads-up — our blackbox embedding probe started failing in us-central when RPS spiked around 18:23. Mostly streaming handshake timeouts + some 524s from the edge.

sre-bot: ALERT → blackbox_probe_failure_rate (job=blackbox-probe, region=us-central) > 5% for 5m :rotating_light:

ajay: Can you paste a short log snippet / the probe request you used?

maria: sure, here's the curl we run from the probe container and a tiny snippet of the tcp handshake logs:
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1","input":"probe ping"}' \\n  https://inference-us-central.redwood/api/v1/embeddings/stream
```
response -> `HTTP/1.1 524` and websocket handshake stalled after SYN/ACK for ~2.6s, then reset. tcp dump shows repeated SYNs, occasional SYN+ACK, then RST from gateway.

kai: Two quick ideas: add client-side jitter + exponential backoff for the probes so they don't thundering-herd into the same node, and bump the probe timeout for streaming endpoints to 8s (was 3s). Also can we surface a `X-KV-HIT` header from runtime when the prefix cache is used so probes can assert cache reuse?

olivia: FWIW we saw KV cache thrash earlier today after a model rollout — prefix evictions caused cold handshakes that push more work to the GPU and occasionally make the gateway delay. If the probe forces a cold open, it looks like a failure even though the app would retry fine. A small probe change: validate `X-KV-HIT: true` in response to mark the probe as success-for-cold-caching-checks.

jordan: Noted cost impact: our gcp billing shows a small bump in GPU minutes aligned with the RPS spike. Probes triggered some autoscaler activity — they look like normal traffic to the autoscaler. We should avoid probe traffic causing GPU spin-ups.

ajay: Proposed short-term mitigations:
- reduce probe qps from 2 rps -> 0.2 rps per probe job in us-central
- add randomized 0-10s jitter to probe start times
- route probes to a probe-only nodepool (label: probe_exempt=false) or a cheap cpu-only path if the endpoint supports a health-check path that doesn't load the GPU

kai: Long-term: runtime should expose a lightweight /healthz that validates HTTP and streaming handshake without allocating a model (or uses smallest quantized variant). Also add a metric `probe_handshake_duration_seconds{probe_type,region,model}` so we can SLO on handshake latency.

ajay: On the observability side I'll add labels: `probe_type=stream|embed`, `region`, `model_variant`. Also push a histogram `probe_handshake_duration_seconds` and a counter `probe_kv_hit_total`. That will let us differentiate cold-cache failures vs real network errors.

olivia: For alerts, can we make them smarter? e.g. only fire if `probe_failure_rate > 5%` AND ( `probe_handshake_duration_seconds{quantile="0.95"} > 2s` OR `gpu_spinup_events > 3` in 10m ). Otherwise we get noisy alerts during canary/model-rollouts.

maria: Agreed. Also add a tiny runbook here so oncall knows what to do before paging infra: 
```
Runbook: probe-handshake-failure (short)
1) Check grafana: Blackbox → Handshake duration heatmap (region/model).
2) Check probes Prometheus: probe_kv_hit_total / probe_runs_total.
3) If kv_hit ratio < 0.5 and recent rollout tag present -> treat as degraded but not incident.
4) If gpu_spinups > 3 in 10m AND probe_failure_rate > 5% -> escalate to infra (possible autoscaler leak).
5) Temporary mitigation: reduce probe QPS and enable `probe_only_nodepool` routing for 30m.
6) Deploy small probe change: add jitter + bump timeout for streaming.
```

sre-bot: NOTE: added annotation `blackbox_probe_runbook_v1` to alert.

deploy-bot: deploy started: blackbox-probe@sha256:af3e... updating probe QPS and jitter config to us-central.

maria: ran a quick canary after deploy (10 probes for 15m) — failure rate dropped from ~6.1% -> 0.8%. handshake_p95 dropped from 2.9s -> 0.7s. CPU-only health hits increased (expected).

jordan: great — cost telemetry shows no extra GPU spinups during the canary window. will keep monitoring billing for next 24h.

ajay: follow-ups:
- I'll open a tiny PR to add `X-KV-HIT` to runtime responses and expose `probe_kv_hit_total`.
- Add Grafana panel to the SLO dashboard: probe_kv_hit_ratio by region/model.
- Tweak alerting rule as discussed.

kai: also recommend we add a synthetic scenario that periodically tries a tiny quantized model variant to ensure the model stack path is exercised but without allocating full GPU.

maria: thanks all — leaving the probe canary running. ping me if anything spikes: @ajay @kai :thumbsup:

sre-bot: RESOLVED alert → blackbox_probe_failure_rate (duration 6m)

(reacts: :white_check_mark:, :chart_with_upwards_trend:)
